input_provenance: Committed mgcv_fs_functional source fixture 2ace31a9840cf9cf6c86efef9abe13c31184f0f5de7acb5643e76fb63bb0a3fd supplies all frozen inputs. Distinct rows use the original tp cases; repeated rows use existing ps repeated cases. Numerical inputs are never regenerated at test time.
execution: Actual installed CRAN mgcv 1.9-4. The probe traces nat.param only to retain its exact X/S/rank inputs, then evaluates the original routine. No derivative, basis or fitting code is replaced. Ordinary tests load static captures without R.
supported_scope: Matrix fs with a tp marginal having exactly one null direction (univariate m=1)
Fixed and REML-selected smoothing at the original source SP units
Unit, varying and constant-row-sum quadrature weights, including zero quadrature rows
Distinct and repeated paired metric/factor packing, prediction width changes and persistence
Function-space/projector and transported individual penalty comparisons; no raw coefficient/column assertions
Fitted/newdata values, standard errors, covariance kernels, EDF and SP references
Scalar derivative-order forwarding: FS(tp,m=1), SZ(tp,m=3), SZ(ts,m=1)
guarded_scope: Matrix tp/fs with more than one independently penalized null direction remains guarded. Frozen-source X/S injection and a deterministic null rotation prove that valid coordinate transport preserves operators, whereas recreating diagonal rank-one penalties after rotation changes anisotropic models. Even equal-null SPs retain an orientation-dependent common scale from smoothCon norm(X,type='I')^2. nat.param unit.fnorm is rotation invariant; no runtime reference-specific rescaling or canonicalization is applied.
validation: Existing fs tolerances retained: 4e-5 fitted/covariance/EDF, 2e-7 basis transport, 3e-6 penalties, 3e-4 absolute/3e-3 relative SP. Source input/projection and operator identities have tighter 2e-8/2e-10 checks. No tolerance was widened. One repeated/constant REML case reports backend step failure at explicit 1e-10 outer controls while its fitted/uncertainty/EDF/SP checks pass; no optimizer rescue is added.
